description: The direct subdivisions of a boundary: a country's states, a state's counties, a city's districts. Without admin_level it picks the next level that exists. Free and public. Use it to build drill-down pickers or to cover a region with its parts.

admin_level.description: Subdivision admin_level; default: the next level below the parent that exists.

id.description: Boundary id: r<OSM relation id> (e.g. r62422 for Berlin) or w<way id>. Also accepts R62422, relation/62422, -62422, an openstreetmap.org URL, wikidata:Q64 or iso:US-CA.

name: list_children
title: List subdivisions
